name: Alchemist
text: You may pay any member’s colored part in any colors.

name: Front-runner
text: You go first every round.

name: HR
text: Worth 3 followers. Game End: +3 followers per color you have 3 members of.

name: Insider
text: You may also recruit from the top 3 of the pile.

name: Launderers
text: Worth 2 followers. On Recruit: rearrange your resources into any colors.

name: Saboteur
text: Whenever this joins your cult, −3 followers.

name: Scout
text: Once per round: send any shop members to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Coach
text: On Recruit: use one of your used Once per game members again.

name: Party Crasher
text: Once per game: your next minion can be placed on a space a rival already took.

name: Tiebreaker
text: Ties you’re in go to you alone.

name: Banker
text: On Recruit: +3 gold. Round Start: +3 gold.

name: Merchant
text: Whenever anyone recruits a gold member, +1 gold.

name: Prospector
text: When an action gains you gold, +1 gold.

name: Treasurer
text: On Recruit: +1 gold per member you have, this one included.

name: Speculator
text: Once per game: double your gold.

name: Tax Collector
text: Whenever a rival buys followers, +1 gold.

name: Penny Pincher
text: Gold you spend on members counts double.

name: Alchemist
text: Whenever an action gains you another color, +1 gold.

name: Tycoon
text: Game end: +1 follower per 2 gold.

name: Underdog
text: While a rival has more gold than you, double your gold gains.

name: Benefactor
text: On Recruit: +3 silver, and +1 silver to a rival you choose. Round Start: +3 silver, and +1 silver to a rival you choose.

name: Caterer
text: Whenever you give a rival something, +1 silver.
